put your downloaded steamworks sdk here

it should be contains:
- glmgr dir
- public dir
- redistributable_bin dir
- steamworksexample dir
- tools dir
- Readme.txt file
- example:
```
.THIS_ROOT_PROJECT
|
|__src
|
|___vendors
|   |
|   |__steamworks-sdk
|       |__glmgr
|       |__public
|       |__redistributable_bin
|       |__steamworksexample
|       |__tools
|       |__NOTE.txt
|       |__Readme.txt
|
|__README.md
```
